# GMAT Mini

> GMAT Mini is an iPhone and iPad app for GMAT practice in short sessions. Each mini quiz has four GMAT-style questions across Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning and Data Insights (the three sections of the GMAT Focus Edition), with a step-by-step explanation after every answer.

Facts:
- 3,000 original practice questions; the first mini quiz is free; one purchase unlocks everything, no subscription.
- A mini quiz is four questions: one per section plus one from a rotating section. You can also practice one section at a time or retry missed questions.
- A countdown timer is hidden by default and can be shown in Settings.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Practice history stays on the device.
- App menus are in 11 languages; questions and explanations are in English.
- Independent study aid, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Graduate Management Admission Council. Scores do not predict a GMAT score.

Guides:
- [How the GMAT Focus Edition sections work](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gmat-mini/gmat-focus-edition-sections.html): three sections, question counts and minutes as published by the Graduate Management Admission Council, question types, and how a mini quiz maps onto them.
- [GMAT practice questions by section](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gmat-mini/gmat-practice-questions.html): question types in each section with two worked examples.
- [GMAT mini quiz: how a four-question daily habit works](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gmat-mini/gmat-mini-quiz.html): what happens in one mini quiz and a simple routine.
